sources.entry: PercentCalculator - A menu bar application that calculates percents.

summary.one_liner: PercentCalculator is a macOS menu bar app that calculates percentages, distributed free on the Mac App Store.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short. It states that PercentCalculator is a menu bar application for calculating percents and that it is available on the Mac App Store for free. A Demo heading is present but has no content. The README does not describe specific calculation modes, interface details, or settings. The repository was listed under the Utilities section of an open-source macOS apps list.
use_cases: quick percent math from the menu bar
work out percentage increase or discount
notable: Lives in the macOS menu bar
Free on the Mac App Store
caveats: README is nearly empty; no build or install steps are given beyond the Mac App Store listing
